header.exampleReplaces: An example replaces the answers on this device.
header.startAgainAsk: Start again? This clears every answer on this device.

lang.suggestWhy: Suggested from your browser's language setting - never from where you are.
lang.switched: Beacon is now in {name}. You can change it any time with the globe button at the top.
lang.official: Official names and rules stay in English, as the organisation writes them.

place.suggest: Looks like you're in {country} (from your browser language). Is that right?
place.never: We only use your country and your council area - never your address.
place.noneBody: Beacon only knows the rules for {covered} today. The results would not fit {country}, so we won't guess.
place.packLine: Rules read from the official pages. Beacon can say Likely.
place.noneLine: No rules for this country yet.
place.ukPlace: Your postcode tells Beacon your nation and council.

first.you: You, or someone you look after
first.mapLabel: You on one side, everyone who gives help on the other, and Beacon connecting the two.
first.headline: {names}, and {more} more
first.lead: As you answer, what may be yours shows up here with the official rule behind it.

chat.hello: Hi, I'm Beacon. I check what help you could be missing, for you or someone you look after.
chat.howTo: Tell me what's going on in your own words, or answer the questions below. You can also talk, or add a photo of a letter.
chat.placeholder: Or tell Beacon in your own words
chat.likelySoFar: {count, plural, one {# looks} other {# look}} likely so far
chat.examplePlay: Here's a made-up example: {name}. {line} Watch the results light up as each answer goes in.
chat.exampleDone: That's every answer that matters for this example. Try your own whenever you're ready, or ask me anything about these results.
chat.shared: This check was shared with you. Change anything in Details, and it stays on this device.
chat.addLetterHint: An agent reads it for you

q.per: {per, select, week {a week} month {a month} year {a year} other {}}
q.errFit: That answer doesn't fit. Try again.
q.errPostcode: Try the full postcode, like HA9 0WS
q.errFuture: That's still to come. Try a past month.
q.errAmount: Try an amount in pounds, like 4000
q.errHours: How many hours a week, roughly?
q.errHoursRange: Try a number of hours between 0 and 168
q.emptyChecklist: Tick any that fit, or 'None of these'
q.emptyWork: Pick the one that fits best
q.emptyOther: Add an answer, or choose 'I'm not sure'

postcode.why: Your nation and council decide many schemes.
postcode.label: Postcode

dob.why: Month and year are enough. Age decides a lot, like State Pension age.
dob.label: Born

benefits.q: Which of these do you already get?
benefits.qThey: Which of these does {n} already get?
benefits.why: Some help opens the door to more help.
benefits.label: Already gets

income.q: How much money comes into your home?
income.qThey: How much money comes into {n}'s home?
income.why: Include wages, pensions and benefits, after tax.
income.label: Income

savings.q: How much do you have in savings?
savings.qThey: How much does {n} have in savings?
savings.why: Some help has a savings limit, often £16,000.
savings.label: Savings

difficulties.q: Because of a health condition, what feels hard day to day?
difficulties.qThey: Because of a health condition, what does {n} find hard day to day?
difficulties.why: This opens disability payments and help getting around.
difficulties.label: Day-to-day help

opts.wash: Washing, dressing or using the toilet
opts.night: Being safe on your own, day or night

work.why: Decides help with jobs, sickness, caring and childcare.
work.label: Work

ni.q: Have you paid National Insurance in the last 2 to 3 years?
ni.qThey: Has {n} paid National Insurance in the last 2 to 3 years?
ni.why: New Style JSA and ESA depend on contributions, not income.
ni.label: Paid National Insurance

child.q: When was your youngest child born?
child.why: Month and year are enough. Family help depends on your child's age.
child.label: Youngest child

pregnant.q: Is anyone at home expecting a baby?
pregnant.qThey: Is anyone in {n}'s home expecting a baby?
pregnant.label: Expecting a baby

careHours.q: How many hours a week do you care for someone?
careHours.qThey: How many hours a week does {n} care for someone?
careHours.why: Carer payments start at 35 hours a week.
careHours.label: Caring hours

housing.why: Renting can open help with the rent.
housing.label: Home

opts.social: Rent from the council or a housing association

household.why: Living alone can take money off the council tax bill.
household.label: Lives with

debt.q: Are you behind on any bills or payments?
debt.qThey: Is {n} behind on any bills or payments?
debt.why: There's free help with debt, and grants that clear energy debts.
debt.label: Behind on bills

bereaved.q: Has someone close to you died recently?
bereaved.qThey: Has someone close to {n} died recently?
bereaved.label: Bereavement

opts.partner: My husband, wife or civil partner
opts.funeral: Someone else, and I'm paying for the funeral
